# MedBound Times

> A Chicago-based medical journalism platform providing clinical research, healthcare news, professional interviews, and educational content for medical students and healthcare professionals.

MedBound Times is a comprehensive medical content platform founded by Dr. Munish Kumar Raizada that combines medical journalism, clinical insights, and professional development resources. The site serves as a hub for healthcare professionals, medical students, and aspiring medical journalists seeking curated medical news, expert interviews, and educational opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Medical Journalism
- Healthcare News
- Medical Education
- Doctor Interviews
- Medical Students

## Core Platform

- [Homepage](https://www.medboundtimes.com): Homepage for MedBound Times medical journals, blogs, and content platform
- [About Us](https://www.medboundtimes.com/about-us): About MedBound Times: Chicago-based medical journalism and healthcare news platform
- [Internships](https://www.medboundtimes.com/internships): Medical journalism and writing internship opportunities at MedBound Times
- [Contact Us](https://www.medboundtimes.com/contact-us): Contact MedBound Times editorial team for guest posts and story ideas

## Interview & Profile Series

- [Healthcare Interviews & Disease Insights](https://www.medboundtimes.com/interview): Exclusive interviews with healthcare professionals and medical students
- [DocScopy](https://www.medboundtimes.com/docscopy): In-depth interviews with clinicians and healthcare experts worldwide
- [DocScopy Med-Teacher](https://www.medboundtimes.com/docscopy/med-teacher): Interview series featuring senior doctors and medical educators
- [Biography | Leading Healthcare Professionals](https://www.medboundtimes.com/biography): Profiles of healthcare professionals and medical pioneers
- [Dr. Munish Kumar Raizada Biography](https://www.medboundtimes.com/biography-munishkumarraizada): Biography of Dr. Munish Kumar Raizada, founder and neonatologist
- [MedSight](https://www.medboundtimes.com/med-sight): Fun trivia and interviews with medical students and recent graduates

## Medical News & Clinical Content

- [Daily Pulse: Trending Medical & Health Updates](https://www.medboundtimes.com/daily-pulse): Curated daily medical news, health updates, and healthcare trends
- [Medicine](https://www.medboundtimes.com/medicine): Medical news, clinical research, and healthcare technology updates
- [Biotechnology](https://www.medboundtimes.com/biotechnology): Biotechnology research, gene editing, and medical innovation news
- [Pharmacy](https://www.medboundtimes.com/pharmacy): Pharmacy news, medication safety, and pharmaceutical industry updates
- [Dentistry](https://www.medboundtimes.com/dentistry): Dental health articles, treatments, and oral care advancements
- [Physical Therapy](https://www.medboundtimes.com/physical-therapy): Physical therapy news, sports medicine, and rehabilitation articles
